# Consumer Optional Infrastructure

Use only the rules that apply to the current consumer task.

## Contents

- [Add infrastructure only through explicit bootstrap options](#add-infrastructure-only-through-explicit-bootstrap-options)

## Add infrastructure only through explicit bootstrap options

Keep Aspire, Docker and Elasticsearch outside the selected profile and add each only after its required package access and application foundation are healthy.

## Preferred approach

Record optional infrastructure in `newheap-consumer.json` and implement only the selected features. With `--aspire`, put the AppHost and service defaults in `src/Back-end/Orchestration`, compose the selected database and API, pass the HTTPS API endpoint to the Angular proxy, and add other resources only when the application uses them. With `--docker`, add and verify the selected Dockerfile or Compose topology. With `--elasticsearch`, keep the client, index mappings, health check and search behavior consumer-owned; NewHeap does not imply Elasticsearch as a baseline dependency.

Add these options after the package gates required by the selected profile succeed. Keep the generated project limited to the confirmed service, API or management capabilities. Identity, relational persistence, CAP, RabbitMQ, media, jobs, Docker and search each require an explicit application need and their own executable checks.

## Avoid

- Adding Aspire, Docker, RabbitMQ or Elasticsearch automatically to every new consumer.
- Treating an optional service as proof that the NewHeap packages or management integration work.
- Hiding selected infrastructure from the manifest or leaving manifest flags enabled after removing its implementation.
- Presenting Elasticsearch as a reusable NewHeap library capability when it is consumer-owned integration.

## Verification

Run the final validator with the manifest feature flags enabled. For Aspire, start the AppHost and confirm database, HTTPS API and management references. For Docker, build or start the declared topology. For Elasticsearch, exercise its health check and one real index/query path. Confirm the same project validates without any requirement for options that remain disabled.
